topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and outlines the learning objectives regarding cancer evolution, cell of origin, and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Drivers of Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications confer competitive fitness and drive clonal expansion in pre-malignant tissues.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tissue stem cell hierarchies and cell-of-origin properties influence tumor initiation and propagation across hematological and solid cancers.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Influences on Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how inflammatory stimuli and supportive stromal microenvironments promote stem-like states, tumor outgrowth, and therapeutic opportunities.

topics.label: Methodologies for Investigating Tumor Evolution and Spatial Interactions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details sequencing technologies, computational modeling, and spatial profiling methods used to study cancer evolution and cell interactions.

topics.label: Integrative Multi-Factorial Model of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors interact to drive the evolutionary process of malignancy.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Lecture Preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and announces the topic for the following session.
